data.summary_en: SEPM unifies online collaboration and procedural memory evolution via task dependency graph, shared blackboard, and reusable process pool, supporting multi-agent collaboration. Across six AutoGen/DyLAN settings on ALFWorld, WebArena, and OfficeBench, scores highest; under AutoGen, gains over no-extra-memory baseline are 29.85, 25.86, and 13.00 percentage points.
